examples.name: line-length-visitor-guide
examples.copy: The studio gives independent makers a place to work, meet and share ideas. Each day pass includes a desk, Wi-Fi and coffee, with access from 09:00 to 18:00. Choose a day before you arrive and bring your booking reference to the welcome desk. If you need a quiet room, ask the team about availability before booking.
